summary: The count invariant for the product-free Lambek calculus of Lambek.v: every derivation, with or without cut, preserves the polarity-weighted count of each primitive type. Its contrapositive gives non-derivability results on the fragment of Lambek.v. The invariant ignores word order, so it is a necessary condition only.

sources.citation: Lambek, J. (1958). The mathematics of sentence structure. Amer. Math. Monthly 65(3):154-170.
Moot, R. & Retoré, C. (2012). The Logic of Categorial Grammars. LNCS 6850. Ch. 2-3.
